Experienced promoter-led management with over two decades in IT infrastructure.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on Government/PSU orders
risks.detail: 83.84% of FY26 revenue came from Government/PSU clients or projects where the end user is Government/PSU. Tender rule changes, delays or loss of eligibility could hurt revenue.

risks.title: High client concentration
risks.detail: Top five clients contributed 76.66% of FY26 revenue. Losing any big client or having a project cancelled would materially hurt earnings.

risks.title: Debt rising sharply
risks.detail: Borrowings rose from Rs 27.26 crore in FY24 to Rs 174.36 crore in FY26 and debt-equity from 0.29 to 0.96. Total borrowings including bank guarantees were Rs 318.55 crore at June 30, 2026. Promoter personal guarantees were Rs 398.85 crore.

risks.title: Negative or weak operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 17.98 crore in FY25 and only Rs 12.48 crore in FY26 against PAT of Rs 45.47 crore; business is working-capital intensive with large receivables of about Rs 513 crore.

risks.title: New and unproven renewable energy business
risks.detail: Renewable EPC contributed 8.93% of FY26 revenue and now forms most of the order book (51.71% EPC, 14.33% PPA, 22.35% BESS at June 2026). Promoters have minimal expertise in this sector.

risks.title: Falling bid success rate and margins
risks.detail: Bid success rate fell from 30.91% in FY24 to 19.48% in FY26. EBITDA margin was 5.42% and PAT margin 3.26% in FY26, versus 7.01% and 4.91% in FY24.

risks.title: Performance bank guarantees and tied-up funds
risks.detail: Company needs PBGs of 3% to 10% of project value backed by fixed deposits; Rs 124.37 crore of Rs 125.40 crore non-fund-based limits were used at March 2026, and Rs 155 crore of the issue is meant for PBGs.

risks.title: Related-party dealings and litigation
risks.detail: Significant dealings with promoter-linked entities including loans from promoters and related-party receivables, plus a pending cheque-dishonour case of Rs 2.78 crore and a contract-staff labour grievance. Promoters hold 92.72% pre-issue.

objects.purpose: Funding incremental working capital requirements

strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 209.58 crore in FY24 to Rs 503.57 crore in FY26 (55% CAGR), and PAT grew about 72% a year.

Asset-light model with leased equipment keeps capital spending low.
Over 15 years in power distribution EPC; 36 projects done and 18 under execution.

risks.title: Extreme client concentration

risks.title: Working-capital heavy and debt funded

risks.title: Large contingent liabilities

risks.title: Related-party dealings

risks.title: Order book execution and delays

risks.title: Promoter guarantees, control and OFS

risks.title: Subcontractor reliance and compliance lapses
